title: Smarter WhatsApp assistant
how: In the team group, write: lumina summary (or: lumina summary yesterday / monday / 12 oct). Add a task to someone from Daily Standup and they get a WhatsApp automatically.
bullets: Group summary now comes split by topic with an Important section on top. Days run 3 AM to 3 AM; ask for yesterday, a weekday or a date like 12 oct.
When someone hands you a task from the Daily Standup, you now get a WhatsApp message straight away.
Reminders list your open tasks one per line, so they are easier to read.
The Calendar counts 9 hours or more as a full day.

title: Ask Lumina who logged in, and when
bullets: Ask the Lumina WhatsApp assistant what time anyone logged in or left, today or on any earlier day.
Ask who has logged in and who hasn't, for today or a past day.
Ask for a whole week or month for one person, or compare two people.
Answers come straight from the attendance records, with work from home days and holidays shown.
how: WhatsApp Lumina, for example: what time did Nupur log in today, did Happy log in on Monday, who hasn't logged in, or attendance last week.

title: Reminders and scheduled group posts by WhatsApp
bullets: Tell Lumina to remind you about anything, any day or time, and it WhatsApps you then.
Ask Lumina to post a message in the team group at a time you choose; it asks you to confirm with a yes first.
Say it the way you like: remind me tomorrow, ping me Friday, post this in the group at 5pm.
A plain yes with nothing waiting is no longer taken as a command.
how: Message Lumina on WhatsApp, for example: remind me tomorrow at 10 to call the client, or: post in the group at 5pm that the meeting moved to 6. Tap the i button on the dashboard to see every update.

title: Tasks from the team group, automatically
bullets: When someone asks you to do something in the team group, Lumina now adds it to your Daily Standup and WhatsApps you straight away.
Client feedback mentioned in the group is sent to that client's owner as soon as it is spotted.
Added by mistake? Tell Lumina that wasn't a task and it removes it.
how: Just write the request in the group, for example: Charu make the Omotec reel by Friday. The person gets a WhatsApp and the task shows in their Daily Standup.

title: Links now included in group summaries
bullets: When you ask Lumina to summarise the team group, the links people shared are now included.
Each link sits under the point it belongs to, and any others are listed at the end under Links shared.
how: In the team group write: lumina summary (or: lumina summary yesterday). The links come with it.
